---
title: "Plot for Recruitment"
---

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
path <- here("data", "analysis-data", "liqplat_recruitment_data.parquet")


file_info <- file.info(path)
recruitment_data <- read_parquet(path) |>
    filter(tx == 1)

random_data <- recruitment_data |>
  select(random_date) |>
  mutate(random_date = as_date(random_date))  |>
  arrange(random_date) |>
  mutate(n = row_number(),
         group = "Random selection for invitation to the trial")

uptake_data <- recruitment_data  |>
  mutate(icf_date = as_date(icddate)) |>
  filter(!is.na(icf_date)) |> # Fixed typo in your original snippet "1"
  select(icf_date) |>
  arrange(icf_date) |>
  mutate(n = row_number(),
         group = "Informed consent signed")

# --- Plotting Preparation ---

# 1. Define custom colors to match Plotly hex codes
custom_colors <- c(
  "Random selection for invitation to the trial" = "#000000",
  "Informed consent signed (Uptake)" = "#068194"
)

# 2. Calculate the center date to mimic xref="paper", x=0.5 for the annotation
# We combine dates from both sets to find the true visual center of the plot
all_dates <- c(random_data$random_date, uptake_data$icf_date)
center_date <- min(all_dates, na.rm = TRUE) +
               (max(all_dates, na.rm = TRUE) - min(all_dates, na.rm = TRUE)) / 2

# --- The ggplot Code ---

plot_recruitment <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = random_data,
            aes(x = random_date, y = n, color = group)) +
  geom_point(data = random_data,
             aes(x = random_date, y = n, color = group)) +
  geom_line(data = uptake_data,
            aes(x = icf_date, y = n, color = paste(group, "(Uptake)"))) +
  geom_point(data = uptake_data,
             aes(x = icf_date, y = n, color = paste(group, "(Uptake)"))) +

  # 3. Target Line and Annotation
  geom_hline(yintercept = 150, linetype = "dashed", color = "#068194") +
  annotate("text", x = center_date, y = 145,
           label = "recruitment target",
           color = "#068194", size = 6, vjust = 1) +

  # 4. Scales and Formatting
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "number of patients",
    limits = c(0, 200),
    breaks = c(0, 50, 100, 150, 200)
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    name = "",
    date_breaks = "3 months",
    date_labels = "%b %Y"
  ) +
  # 5. Theme Configurations
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray80"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray95"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black")
  )

plot_recruitment

ggsave(
  here("0-main-analysis", "img", "recruitment_plot.png"),
  plot = plot_recruitment,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```
